product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides customizable dental practice management software that combines scheduling, billing, and patient records for dental practices of any size.

pricing_page.notes: Public “Fees for Support and Services” page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 221 associated employees; the company’s own history article says it has over 300 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Original developer Jordan Sparks maintains “Jordan’s blog” on the company-hosted forum, with multiple technical posts about background database queries and WinForms-to-WPF migration; this is separate from the marketing blog.

public_docs.notes: Public REST API documentation includes numerous resource articles. Comprehensive customer help is restricted, but public developer documentation and a Quick Manual are available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active openings are Dental Assistant/Software Support and Daycare Aide; neither is a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: A natively integrated third-party provider of AI-generated radiograph analysis; the cited page does not identify its underlying model.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims to follow HIPAA security and privacy guidelines and standards; this is a compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports no funding rounds, and Dealroom reports no known external funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No known external funding or funding rounds are reported.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither of the actively listed openings is an SDR, BDR, or account executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 26.1 became stable on August 6, 2026. The August 13 announcement describes ODTouch 25, customizable insurance-history categories, and HTML billing emails.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP appointment or departure was verified for the requested window; available leadership profiles lack sufficient tenure information to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed job descriptions and native integrations page did not identify a qualifying CRM or sales/marketing platform used by the company.
